text: What to do if your girlfriend is a misandrist. Another crazy question. Hello, sorry for bad grammar. I have a question for you. About 3 months ago I found out that my girlfriend of 8 months is a misandrist and gets frustrated at me when I try to speak to her about it. Already I have a lot of questions. Are you using the word misandrist correctly here? Because I suppose you are a man, and if your girlfriend hates men, then how does she have a boyfriend? And another thing, you say you've been together for 8 months, and only 3 months ago you found out about it? What was in the first 5 months? I guess it's not something that is very easy to hide, no? She has said that it's caused by the men in her life, such as her dad and brothers being a little racist and making misogynistic jokes, so I get where she's coming from. I have been tolerating it until now, but recently this has been really affecting our relationship by making me feel like she hates me because I'm a man, and by her saying that she doesn't view me as a man because I don't act like one. So she hates you because you are a man, but at the same time she doesn't view you as a man because you don't act like one? She should pick a side, no? If she doesn't see you like a man, shouldn't it be a positive thing for her? She thinks acting like a man includes things like beating or sexually assaulting women. What should I do? Well, I guess there is one thing you can do, right? Should I break up with her or should I keep tolerating it until she realizes that not all men are bad people? Okay, guys and girls, please have higher standards. If you are with a person who hates other people based simply on a gender, not on their character traits, not on their actions, but on a gender, leave that person. This person is normally bad herself or himself, and it's just a matter of time when that treatment will start to be used towards you. I would even go further and say, if you see that other person treats other people disrespectfully simply because they can get away with it, it tells you enough about that person. As an example, imagine you go to a cafe or restaurant with a date, and you see that your date is rude towards the waiter or bartender or someone else who didn't do anything wrong to deserve that. That's it, that is your clue to understand who is in front of you. So yes, if in your situation you are not happy in a relationship, if your girl hates you or other men simply on the basis of a gender, you deserve better. Break up, work on yourself, and try to find a girl who will love, cherish, and respect you. Thanks a lot, my name is Ilyas Abdullin, and bye!
